import java.io.PrintWriter;

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		Scanner s = new Scanner(new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in)));

		int m = s.nextInt();
		if (n > m) {
			solve(m, n);
		} else {
			solve(n, m);
		}

	}

	private static void solve(int n, int m) {
		if (n == 1) {
			System.out.println(m / 6 * 3 + Math.max(m % 6 - 3, 0) << 1);
		} else if (n == 2) {
			System.out.println(m == 2 ? 0 : m == 3 ? 4 : m == 7 ? 12 : m << 1);
		} else {
			System.out.println(1l * n * m / 2 * 2);
		}

	}
}
